about: The load test's pass marks (docs/plans/S8/S8-7.md), written before any run. web/scripts/load-test.ts judges the measured ones and the database log's count of refused connections, and exits non-zero when one fails. The Cloud Run instance mark waits for the owner: the kit prints the peak against the limit without judging it. The owner reads the byHand ones from the test project's charts and records them with the run (S8-22).
byHand: Database connections stayed under max_connections less 10
